sources.finding: Named church-building polygon on Kirkøy with representative point 59.03267, 11.02568.
Church entity linked to Kulturminne ID 84680, Church of Norway building ID 444 and SSR 790650, with the official address Svanekilveien 11.
Official current church identity and visitor address at Svanekilveien 11, 1680 Skjærhalden.
Municipal history describes the stone church as probably built around 1100 and among Norway's oldest stone churches.

datingDecision.reason: Published sources vary between the late eleventh century and the first half of the twelfth century. Coordinate production preserves that uncertainty instead of asserting one exact construction year.
